newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Barings' deals see huge trade in Ellerine.
newsitem.headline: Barings' deals see huge trade in Ellerine.

text.p: A series of huge deals by broker ING Barings saw massive volumes in South African furniture firm Ellerine Holdings Ltd as shares worth more than 219 million rands changed hands.
Dealers said three Barings deals boosted volumes to more than 6.2 million shares.
They included a foreign purchase of 2.8 million shares, a bookover of 2.0 million shares and an asset swap of 1.6 million shares.
Barings dealers confirmed the trades had taken place, but gave no further financial details.
By 1336 GMT Ellerine's stock had dropped 50 cents to 35.50 rand.

Ellerine forms part of the Johannesburg Stock Exchange's furniture sector which has soared to record levels in recent weeks on hopes on an interest rate cut and as industry sales have started picking up.
